notes: §2002:13.16.52.3 GR3: each addition into the sum counter is tested for size error and 'if a size error occurs, the associated size error indicator is set'; nothing is raised at the addition, and GR4 raises EC-REPORT-SUM-SIZE when the entry is presented. SumEntry.Add sets the indicator and leaves the counter as ADD ON SIZE ERROR leaves it; CobolReport.Accumulate raises only where DialectBehavior.SumSizeErrorRaisedAtAddition is active (2014 and later, VCR row 7.82); SumPresentable raises at the presentation from 2002. The witness checks EC-REPORT-SUM-SIZE with a declarative: at --std 2002 GEN1 DONE, GEN2 DONE (the overflowing GENERATE raises nothing), RAISED 1 at TERMINATE; at 2014 and 2023 RAISED 1 at the second GENERATE (kb/Work PB5643).
